body.contents:
Greetings!

Oh man, today we have QUITE the update. There are SOO MANY THINGS.

Lets start off with the boring stuff though:

---Bug Fixes---
- Fixed bug that made getting all 3 effects less likley
- Fixed bug on the patch notes menu where update 26.10.12 displayed the wrong item
- Fixed bug where items randomly become unbreakable for certain players

---Known Bugs---
- Apparently the dragon egg's ability still doesn't work

---UI Updates---
- New "ATM" button where you can convert Diamonds, Netherite, and Elytras.
- Submenu for new "Spawner" item


Alright, now lets get onto the BIG things: THE NEW ITEMS!!! These are the most COMPLICATED items yet!

---Items---
Spawners:
- Cow
- Creeper
- Pig
- Sheep
- Skeleton
- Villager

THE ANIMAL CARRIER (Idea by Gamrac):
Allows you to pick up certain passive mobs and keep all their data the same, that means name tags, armor, all of it! It would absurd for me to do this for all 87 mobs in the game, so here is a list of all the ones that it currently works for:
-Pig
-Sheep
-Cow
-Horse
-Chicken

If there's anything not on the list that you want me to add put it in #custom-item-suggestions and I'll let you know if I add it!

Now you might be wondering: "Oh Toadec! WHERE IS MY NETHERITE STAFF????". To that I say "HEY BUB. I SPENT MY ENTIRE FALL BREAK MAKING THIS... it will be expand on and added later."
So yeah. BUT DON'T WORRY. When it gets added it will be really cool!

That's all folks, I'll see you in a bit for the next update!
